patthana11.16:3.1: na anidassanaappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cha.

patthana11.16:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana11.16:8.1: hetuyā tiṃsa ārammaṇe nava sabbattha vitthāro.
